Firebase._comment: Firebase project id. Drives the JWT authority/issuer (https://securetoken.google.com/<id>) and audience.

Push._comment: FCM push notifications. Disabled by default so local dev/CI run without live Firebase credentials (#103). Set ServiceAccountPath via the gitignored appsettings.Development.json or a deployment secret, never here.

Moderation._comment: Display-name moderation (DR-002b). Set ModeratorUids and Email:Password via env vars or the gitignored appsettings.Development.json, never here. Empty Email:Host = alerts are logged only.

Seq._comment: Self-hosted Seq search UI. Empty = disabled. Set to e.g. http://localhost:5341 (locally, via appsettings.Development.json) once a Seq container is running.

GameRules._comment: FR1: every tunable game-rule number. Bump Version on ANY change. Missing or invalid values stop the server at startup. Loop/Gps/AutoEnd/SafetyAlarm values are sent to the app; Gap, AntiCheat and Guests stay server-only.
